inputs.label: Super Mario 64 ROM (USA, .z64)
inputs.help: Your own unmodified Super Mario 64 US ROM as a .z64 file.

steps.text: Open SM64 Co-Op DX VR from Library > Unknown Sources and pick your ROM in the file picker. The app imports it and will likely close; open it again and play. To update, install over the old version. Do not uninstall it, or you lose the imported ROM, saves and settings.

notes: Some releases also carry a Steam Frame APK; the pattern takes only the Quest one. Mods and DynOS packs (/sdcard/SM64VR/) need All files access and are not modelled. Never uninstall: the imported ROM and saves are in private storage.
